description: Per-character combat-VFX tuning: aura/disappearance colors, effect IDs for cursed-energy and tension level changes, Niagara color parameters, and per-technique effect scale/offset vectors consumed through IGameActorInterface.

ID.technical: FName primary key (ImportKeyField=Id in the export). Resolved by AGameCharacter::ResolveDataRows into Character::EffectRow (+0x3C8), by battle asset collectors (DTM +0x4D0) and by AGameShikigami::EffectRow (+0x348). Missing rows are handled as null in most callers; aura update code has an unguarded dereference.

bUseAuraEffectEnabled.simple: Whether this character participates in the cursed-energy aura slot system.
bUseAuraEffectEnabled.technical: bool, constructor default false. UpdateCursedEnergyAura returns immediately when false (no slot 0/1 effects are removed or spawned); exported rows set it true for characters with auras. Tension auras are handled separately and do not check this flag.

CursedEnergy_AuraColor.technical: FLinearColor, default (1,1,1,1); exported values can exceed 1 (HDR, e.g. R=5.6, B=10). Applied as UNiagaraComponent::SetColorParameter('AuraColor') on cursed-energy level-up and aura effects and from character/controller callbacks on equipped aura components.

CursedEnergy_BrightAuraColor.simple: Niagara 'BrightAuraColor' parameter for the bright core of cursed-energy effects.
CursedEnergy_BrightAuraColor.technical: FLinearColor, default (1,1,1,1), often HDR-bright in the export. Set alongside CursedEnergy_AuraColor on the same Niagara components at the same call sites.

Disappear_FogColor.simple: Niagara 'FogColor' parameter for the character's down/disappear effect.
Disappear_FogColor.technical: FLinearColor, default (1,1,1,1). FGameCharacterAction's down-end effect (FX_CP_000_17301) sets this color parameter on all its Niagara components from the owner's EffectRow.

Disappear_GlowColor.simple: Niagara 'GlowColor' parameter for the character's down/disappear effect.
Disappear_GlowColor.technical: FLinearColor, default (1,1,1,1), set on the same Niagara components as Disappear_FogColor at down-end.

Id_Effect_CursedEnergy_LevelUp.simple: Effect ID spawned when the cursed-energy level increases.
Id_Effect_CursedEnergy_LevelUp.technical: FName effect ID; when non-None it replaces the built-in default FX_CP_000_07112 in StatusController's level-up branch. The spawned effect's Niagara components are then tinted with the aura colors above. None keeps the default.

Id_Effect_CursedEnergy_Aura_2.simple: Effect ID for cursed-energy level 2 aura.
Id_Effect_CursedEnergy_Aura_2.technical: FName; when non-None it replaces default FX_CP_000_07121 in effect slot 0. UpdateCursedEnergyAura first removes slots 0 and 1, so changing levels swaps the aura; the Coercion buff overrides the chosen ID with FX_CP_020_00341.

Id_Effect_CursedEnergy_Aura_3.simple: Effect ID for cursed-energy levels 3 and 4 aura.
Id_Effect_CursedEnergy_Aura_3.technical: FName; when non-None it replaces default FX_CP_000_07131 in effect slot 1. Level 3 and 4 share the slot/ID; level 2 uses Aura_2. Coercion also overrides this ID.

Id_Effect_Tension_LevelUp.simple: Effect ID spawned when the tension level increases.
Id_Effect_Tension_LevelUp.technical: FName; on OldLevel < NewLevel a non-None value is passed to SpawnOwnerEffect(-1, id) after tension aura slot updates. No alternate default is supplied when None.

Id_Effect_Tension_Aura_2.simple: Effect ID for tension level 2 aura.
Id_Effect_Tension_Aura_2.technical: FName; when non-None it is spawned in effect slot 2 after slots 2 and 3 are removed. No default ID is applied for tension aura slots.

Id_Effect_Tension_Aura_3.simple: Effect ID for tension levels 3 and 4 aura.
Id_Effect_Tension_Aura_3.technical: FName; when non-None it is spawned in effect slot 3 for tension level 3 or 4 (same slot for both levels).

BuffDebuffEffectScale.simple: Scale applied to buff/debuff effect actors attached to this character.
BuffDebuffEffectScale.technical: FVector returned by AGameCharacter::GetEffectRow()->BuffDebuffEffectScale; several character action controllers and the status controller call Effect->SetActorScale3D with it when spawning buff/debuff visuals. Defined on the owner (or target, for CN_250) rather than on the effect row.

MapGroundEffectScale.simple: Scale for ground/map effects spawned by this character.
MapGroundEffectScale.technical: FVector returned by the IGameActorInterface override on AGameCharacter/AGameShikigami; action controllers apply it with SetActorScale3D to ground/run/dash effects. Interface fallback is OneVector when the implementing actor has no row.

SimpleDomainCounterEffectScale.simple: Scale of the simple-domain counter hit effect.
SimpleDomainCounterEffectScale.technical: FVector exposed via IGameActorInterface::GetSimpleDomainCounterEffectScale (default OneVector); CN_200 actions set the counter hit effect's actor scale from the counter target's value.

CrimsonBindEffectScale.simple: Scale of Crimson Bind/restraint effects in projection sorcery.
CrimsonBindEffectScale.technical: FVector exposed through the actor interface; projection-sorcery actions apply it to the binding and restraint effect actors with SetActorScale3D.

CrimsonBindEffectOffset.simple: Local offset of the Crimson Bind restraint effect.
CrimsonBindEffectOffset.technical: FVector exposed through the actor interface; projection-sorcery code rotates it by FRotator(90, 0, -90) and applies it as the restraint effect's relative location. Interface default is ZeroVector.

ProjectionSorceryEffectScale.simple: Scale for projection-sorcery frame and shatter effects.
ProjectionSorceryEffectScale.technical: FVector exposed through IGameActorInterface; projection-sorcery actions apply it to spawned frame and shatter effect actors (multiple setup/shatter call sites). Interface default OneVector.

ProjectionSorceryEffectOffset.simple: Offset of projection-sorcery frame effects relative to the owner's root rotation.
ProjectionSorceryEffectOffset.technical: FVector exposed through the actor interface; ProjectionFrameTransform adds GetRootRotation().RotateVector(this value) to the owner's location when positioning frame effects. Interface default ZeroVector.

ProjectionSorceryWeaponLocation.simple: Relative location used to pin weapon 0 during projection sorcery.
ProjectionSorceryWeaponLocation.technical: FVector read directly from Character::EffectRow; PinProjectionWeapon calls AGameWeapon::SetActorRelativeLocation with it when the character has a weapon at index 0. Unpin restores a zero offset.

ProjectionSorceryWeaponRotation.simple: Relative rotation used to pin weapon 0 during projection sorcery.
ProjectionSorceryWeaponRotation.technical: FRotator read directly from Character::EffectRow; passed to AGameWeapon::SetActorRelativeRotation next to ProjectionSorceryWeaponLocation. Export values are Pitch/Yaw/Roll in degrees.

FreezingRestraintEffectScale.technical: FVector exposed via IGameActorInterface; restraint actions apply it to the spawned freezing restraint effect actor with SetActorScale3D. Interface default OneVector.

FreezingRestraintEffectOffset.simple: Root-rotation-relative offset of freezing restraint effects.
FreezingRestraintEffectOffset.technical: FVector exposed via IGameActorInterface; restraint actions rotate it by the owner's root rotation before positioning the effect. Interface default ZeroVector.

CentipedeRestraintEffectOffset.simple: Additional world offset for the centipede restraint/down effect.
CentipedeRestraintEffectOffset.technical: FVector exposed via IGameActorInterface (slot +0x538); GameCharacterAction_Blow adds it to GetFallEffectOffset() when computing the down-effect location. Interface default ZeroVector.

FileName_BP.simple: Array of effect Blueprint asset names preloaded for this character.
FileName_BP.technical: TArray<FName>, row +0x1A8. BattleAssets_CharacterEffects_12BC550 appends the whole array to battle preload lists; GamePhase_BattlePreload creates Effect-primary asset loaders from them (StudioCharacterEffectLoaders). No effect row is also looked up via the generic EffectDataTable paths for actual spawning; those use separate EffectDataTable IDs.

notes: Export contains 47 rows. Color values are FLinearColor and can exceed 1.0 (HDR); the JSON export's Hex field is a display aid, not a separate property.
Character rows and shikigami rows both carry Id_CharacterEffect; AGameShikigami caches the same row type at +0x348 and uses the interface scale/offset getters too.
Several scale/offset fields are reached only through IGameActorInterface virtual overrides; the interface defaults (OneVector/ZeroVector) apply to other actor types, not to characters with this row.
Only default values in the row constructor are bUseAuraEffectEnabled=false and the four colors=(1,1,1,1); FVector/FRotator/name-array fields are left at their type defaults.
Single table asset 'CharacterEffectDataTable' loaded into DTM +0x4D0; no numbered shards or locale variants in the export.
Reconstructed source with cited retail RVAs; some callers dereference the row unguarded. No claim about Blueprint-only consumers, uncooked assets, or byte-identical matching.

usages.detail: Caches the row as AGameCharacter::EffectRow for all gameplay consumers.
Aura gate and cursed-energy aura/level-up effect selection and tinting.
Tension aura level and level-up effect selection.
Preloads all effect Blueprints named by FileName_BP.
Projection-sorcery effects use the scale/offset/weapon-pinning fields.
Freezing restraint effects use the offset and scale getters.
